cases.description: When a newly constructed Message has never had a Resolver assigned, the internal field `resolver` is null. `getResolver()` should therefore return an empty Optional.
After a Resolver instance is injected via `setResolver(mockResolver)`, `getResolver()` must return an Optional containing the exact same Resolver object.
If the Resolver is explicitly cleared by calling `setResolver(null)`, `getResolver()` should again return an empty Optional.
